tiles: Radiant closed-eye portraits with euphoric color
Surreal calm rendered in impression maximalism
challenge: Blending multiple art-historical traditions, psychedelic color, synthetist simplification, fauvist energy, and impressionist maximalism, into a unified portrait series requires precise creative direction. Each piece needed to convey euphoric calm through radiant palettes and simplified forms while maintaining enough visual complexity to reward sustained viewing. The closed-eye motif demanded compositions that communicate emotional depth without the anchor of eye contact.
approach: Used a generative pipeline to establish base color fields and form simplification for each portrait, then refined edge flow, hue relationships, and glow discipline through in-painting. The series draws on synthetist flattening of form, fauvist liberation of color from representation, and psychedelic radiance to create portraits that feel simultaneously serene and visually intense. Each composition balances simplified facial forms against richly layered atmospheric backgrounds.
result: Delivered a cohesive collection of radiant portrait studies that work effectively as editorial content, social media visuals, and large-format prints. The series demonstrates the ability to synthesize multiple art-historical influences into a distinctive visual language using generative tools, showcasing both creative direction depth and technical finishing discipline.
